name: number-input
title: Number Input
description: A React number input and quantity stepper built on Base UI NumberField, with press and hold repeat, keyboard and mouse wheel stepping, Intl number formatting, digits that roll in the direction the value moved, and a cart variant whose minus button becomes a remove button at the minimum.
author: Wensity <hey@wensity.com>

theme.font-sans: var(--font-satoshi, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif)
theme.font-display: var(--font-satoshi, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif)

light.primitive-font-mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

dark.primitive-font-mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

docs: Free Wensity component. Installs to @components/wensity/number-input.tsx. For Pro components and updates, use pnpm dlx wensity@latest add number-input.
